text: login: timing side channel enumerates accounts, contradicting the README's no-enumeration claim

Done in fe527d5. auth._TIMING_EQUALIZER_HASH is generated once at import and verified against when no account row matches. Tested by call count, not wall clock, so it cannot go flaky on a loaded box. README claim at server/README.md corrected rather than removed - it is now true, with a note on what it was before.
